title: The danger next door
summary: Hundreds of Philadelphians live next to dangerous abandoned buildings. The city stopped using its tool to track vacant properties and now relies on residents’ complaints.

title: For Philly-area immigrants, an ICE arrest can take them thousands of miles from home. Some say that’s by design.
summary: An analysis of nearly 20,000 ICE transfers shows how detention can move people far from their families, lawyers and support networks.

title: How Camden tells the story of Mikie Sherrill’s big win and New Jersey’s blue wave
summary: Camden’s election returns show how Sherrill won back voters and reversed Republican gains from 2024.

title: Josh Shapiro may be the biggest fundraising juggernaut Pennsylvania politics has ever produced
summary: Campaign finance filings show that Shapiro raised more than any Pennsylvania governor since at least 2010 as he sought a second term.

title: Did ward endorsements make a difference in Philly’s DA race?
summary: An analysis of Philadelphia’s district attorney primary tests whether ward endorsements still matter after accounting for other factors.

title: Immigration courts in Pa., N.J., and Del. issued record number of deportation orders in June
summary: Court records show about 46,000 removal or voluntary departure orders across the three states since Trump returned to office, more than during Biden’s full term.
